name: Driveway
author: Greg DeYoung
description: Every drive you own, one click from the bar: thumb drives, disks, SD cards, SMB/NFS/sshfs shares and rclone cloud mounts — mounted, browsed, opened and ejected from one tabbed panel. Mapped network drives remount at login; cloud remotes ride supervised systemd units with health states, pending-upload awareness and per-drive disk-cache limits. Settings live right in the panel.

barWidget.description: All drives, one panel: mount, open, eject

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Fallback poll; plugging a drive in refreshes right away.

schema.label: Show unmounted drives
schema.description: Plugged-in drives that aren't mounted yet appear with a Mount (or Unlock) button.

schema.label: Thumb drive size limit (GB)
schema.description: USB disks this size or smaller count as thumb drives unless the model name says otherwise.

schema.label: Nearly full at (%)
schema.description: Usage bars and the bar icon turn urgent at this fill level.
